name: Sculpfun S30 Pro 10W
tagline: Mid Sculpfun S30 Pro : 10W on the S30 frame family
tldr: Sculpfun S30 Pro 10W is the lower-power S30 Pro SKU : same frame class as Pro Max but less cutting depth. Good budget Sculpfun if you don't need 20W.
mainObjective: Affordable S30-frame Sculpfun for engraving-first work

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S30 Pro 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
